subject: Token-mix sprint and contract-path discussion
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@oliveretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Token-mix sprint and contract-path discussion

Hi Daniel —

Following up on our Q4 usage spike, attached is a short consumption summary I pulled this morning (see attachment). Highlights up front: 
- Monthly token spend up 42% vs. Q4 baseline, largely driven by an image-to-text reranking flow and more chat sessions hitting long histories.
- Token mix shift: ~28% of spend is now on 8k-context models for multi-turn flows; 60% of calls are short (<=64 tokens) and could benefit from a smaller fast model.
- Average generation latency for the heavy flows is 210ms; tail P95 at ~680ms.

I'd like to align on a 30–60 day ‘token-mix sprint’ to reduce unit costs while preserving response quality. Proposed agenda for a 30-minute review:
1) Walk the consumption summary and where the spend is concentrated
2) Map short-term options (burst credits, re-routing to a smaller base model for short calls, KV-prefix caching)
3) Present two contract-path scenarios: modest commit uplift vs. short-term bridge with burst credits

Can you share availability for next week? I’ll bring Ben (cost/commits) and Marissa (ops/rollouts) to cover the runway and implementation timeline.

Attachments: 20270112-oliveretail-consumption-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Sofia — this looks useful and timely. Quick notes:
- We were surprised by the burst on image reranking — that's a spike tied to a promotional week (Jan 2–5).
- The long chat histories are intentional for certain cohorts; can't shorten them broadly without a UX change.

Let's do Tue 18th at 10am PT for a 30-min sync. I'll loop in Liam (product) and procurement after the call if the commit options look reasonable.

Dan

Sofia / Marissa —

Quick internal note before we meet with Daniel: I sketched three commit scenarios and the economics are attached in a short PDF (internal). Key differences:
A) Conservative: +15% commit, 6-month term add-on, leftover burst credits for Jan–Mar; minimal price change
B) Moderate: +40% commit, 12-month term, additional volume-tier discount at 2M tokens/month
C) Aggressive: +70% commit, 12–18 month ramp with built-in re-quantization plan and rollout assistance (Marissa to confirm ops SLA)

If we're recommending scenario B as the sweet spot, we'll need a short implementation checklist: cache rules, model fallback policy, and quick audit of the image-reranking pipeline to gate burst routing.

Top-level view (attached "oliveretail-econ-scenarios.pdf"):
- Scenario 1 (Bridge): 6-month bridge + burst credits, no long-term price change, ~10% near-term spend reduction from KV caching and smaller-model routing.
- Scenario 2 (Commit+Optimize): 12-month commit (+40%), dedicated onboarding for the token-mix sprint, expected 22–28% reduction in unit cost within 60 days after rollout because of batching + model-tiering.

Can you confirm whether Procurement needs a draft SOW before the 18th? If so we'll include a short SOW appendix in the follow-up.

1) SLA/latency question: the P95 tail you mentioned (680ms) — what's the expected improvement window if we adopt KV-prefix caching + a smaller short-call model? We need to ensure our checkout flow stays sub-350ms median.
2) Procurement asked whether we can start with a 6-month bridge and then auto-convert to a 12-month commit if 90-day quality gates are met (auto-convert language). Is that standard?

Also attaching a short internal request: can you confirm a DocuSign draft for the bridge option so Procurement can start review?

Daniel —

Recap and next steps from our side:
- Latency: With KV-prefix caching and reroute of short calls to the 4k-fast model, we typically see median drop to ~200–240ms and P95 drop to ~320–380ms in similar workloads (we'll share a short benchmark that matches your checkout pattern). Ops will instrument the KV rules to avoid cold-cache misses for your highest-value cohort.
- Contract path: We can do a 6-month bridge (bridge SKU + burst credits) with a DocuSign draft today that includes an auto-convert clause to a 12-month commit contingent on passing the 90-day quality gates (mutually defined). Procurement should be able to review the draft; I’ve added the DocuSign link below.
- Actions:
  1) I'll send the DocuSign bridge draft to Procurement (procurements@oliveretail.com) today.
  2) Ben will scope the implementation checklist and propose cutover dates (target: week of Feb 1).
  3) Marissa will schedule a short ops kickoff to instrument caching rules and run a small-scale A/B on the checkout flow.

DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/link/oliveretail-commit-draft
Benchmarks + small-run plan: https://app.redwood.com/deals/OLV-2027-RNW-42
